panels.title: Inserted rows / sec
panels.description: From system.metric_log. Watch this while running the async-insert exercise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, sum(ProfileEvent_InsertedRows) AS inserted_rows FROM system.metric_log WHERE event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active parts (PartsActive metric)
panels.description: THE chart for insert health. Spiky growth = too many small inserts. Sawtooth = merges keeping up.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, max(CurrentMetric_PartsActive) AS active_parts FROM system.metric_log WHERE event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 10 second) AS time, quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95 FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind = 'Select' AND event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rows read per SELECT (avg)
panels.description: Schema/index quality. If you read 20M rows to answer a 1-row question, your ORDER BY is wrong.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 10 second) AS time, avg(read_rows) AS avg_rows_read FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind = 'Select' AND event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT event_time AS time, max(CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking) AS memory FROM system.metric_log WHERE event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT event_time AS time, max(CurrentMetric_Merge) AS merges FROM system.metric_log WHERE event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT event_time AS time, sum(ProfileEvent_AsyncInsertQuery) AS async_inserts FROM system.metric_log WHERE event_time >= $__fromTime AND event_time <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT table, count() AS active_parts, sum(rows) AS rows, formatReadableSize(sum(data_compressed_bytes)) AS compressed, formatReadableSize(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes)) AS uncompressed, round(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) / sum(data_compressed_bytes), 2) AS ratio FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'lab' GROUP BY table ORDER BY sum(data_compressed_bytes) DESC
